name: Sydney · Rozelle
verticalDatum: AHD, as stored in the source 3dm (not recentred)

translationFromLocal.description: Loose meshes in the source 3dm are in local metres. MGA = local + translation. Block instances were ignored so geometry is not duplicated.

origin.description: GLB vertex positions are relative to this origin so float32/int16 precision holds. XY is the MGA bounding-box centre of the buildings file (the bridge sits inside that box). Z is 0, so vertex Z stays in AHD metres.

files.compression: none (no Draco, no meshopt). Positions use KHR_mesh_quantization int16 with a uniform node scale. three.js GLTFLoader decodes this natively without an extra decoder. CityCut has no DRACOLoader or MeshoptDecoder wired up.
files.buildingIdAttribute: _BUILDING_ID (UNSIGNED_SHORT, index into root extras.buildingIds; also extras.buildings vertex/index ranges on each mesh)
files.normals: omitted; compute on load if lighting needs them

files.compression: none (no Draco, no meshopt). Same KHR_mesh_quantization encoding, same origin as buildings.glb (scale is file-specific).
files.normals: omitted; compute on load if lighting needs them

files.description: One feature per building (true 2D union of projected triangles, not a convex hull) plus one feature for the Anzac Bridge deck. Properties: id, layer, baseZ, topZ, role (building | slab | structure).

notes: Do not instantiate the source 3dm block instances; they reference the same meshes.
Layer0 contains two junk slivers. rozelle-3823 has a ~0.00005 m² footprint; rozelle-3822 is a nearly vertical sliver with no polygonal projection and is omitted from footprints.geojson.

Slabs are marked where the true (non-hull) footprint is ≥1 ha: five context meshes (a basin at z=-13..5.5, plus podia / plates). A sixth mesh (rozelle-1795) has a 53,897 m² convex hull but only an 8,860 m² true outline, so it is tagged role=building.
The bridge is a structure over water and the Western Distributor, not a building. Use the true deck projection (anzac-bridge-deck), not a convex hull, when testing overlaps.
Source .3dm files are not part of this pack.
